objective.name: matter.append
objective.description: Append one contiguous block of opaque bytes to brique-managed matter substance.

#root.role: Append raw inline or leased bytes with optional optimistic revision, byte-size, and line-count guards.

data._comment: Required for inline append and mutually exclusive with http_data=true. Raw UTF-8 by default or base64 when encoding is base64. Objects and arrays are never implicitly JSON-marshaled. Decoded bytes must not exceed inline_max_bytes (256 KiB by default).

http_data._comment: Optional. Request a one-shot HTTP PUT lease for a large append.

expected_byte_size._comment: Optional committed byte-size guard. Zero is valid.

expected_line_count._comment: Optional committed line-count guard, valid only for lines framing.

http_data._comment: Present instead of final coordinates when an HTTP append lease is opened.

effects.matter_substance: One contiguous block is appended transactionally.
effects.matter_descriptor: Revision and engine-owned committed dimensions advance.
effects.notifications: Subscribers receive matter_appended after commit, without business bytes.

transformation_contract.morphing: Opaque input bytes become one committed contiguous tail block.
invariants: Append is supported only for brique-managed substance.
Bytes are canonical; line coordinates supplement them only in lines framing.
A non-empty line-framed substance and each appended block end with LF.
All supplied guards must match under the per-matter write lock.
The engine never parses JSONL or any other business format.
success: Returns the new strictly greater revision and exact committed coordinates.
failure: Any invalid payload, stale guard, framing violation, or storage failure leaves no partially visible logical commit; startup recovery rolls an interrupted physical commit forward.
Inline data above inline_max_bytes is refused with reason=payload_too_large; data and http_data=true cannot be supplied together.
